results.snippet: Wedding Daze (originally titled The Pleasure of Your Company) is a 2006 American romantic comedy film written and directed by Michael Ian Black and starring Jason Biggs and Isla Fisher alongside Joe Pantoliano, Joanna Gleason, Edward Herrmann, and Michael Weston.
